summary: Blakeman identifies as "a Zionist and a proud Zionist," marched for Israel, and in a 2026 gubernatorial debate issued graphic warnings about anti-Israel protesters while attacking his opponent's Israel stance. He also demanded New York adopt the IHRA working definition of antisemitism, criticizing the mayor's removal of it. His public statements consistently defend Israel and cast opposition to it as a threat to Jewish communities.
